import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long HUGE_INF = 17446744073709551616L;
    static long modVal, totalN, totalK;
    static long[][] dpTable = new long[19][300005];
    static long[] factorials = new long[300005], invFactorials = new long[300005];

    static long fastExponent(long base, long exp) {
        long result = 1L;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1L) == 1L) result = (result * base) % modVal;
            base = (base * base) % modVal;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static long nCr(int a, int b) {
        return (((factorials[a] * invFactorials[b]) % modVal) * invFactorials[a - b]) % modVal;
    }

    static long compute() {
        int i, j, mask;
        factorials[0] = 1L;
        long limit = Math.max(totalN, totalK);
        for (i = 1; i <= limit; i++) {
            factorials[i] = (factorials[i - 1] * i) % modVal;
        }
        invFactorials[(int)limit] = fastExponent(factorials[(int)limit], modVal - 2);
        for (i = (int)limit - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            invFactorials[i] = (invFactorials[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % modVal;
        }
        for (i = 1; i <= totalN; i++) {
            dpTable[1][i] = invFactorials[i];
        }
        long totalAnswer = (dpTable[1][(int)totalN] * nCr((int)totalK, 1)) % modVal;
        int maxIter = (int)Math.min(18, totalK);
        for (i = 2; i <= maxIter; i++) {
            for (j = (int)totalN; j > 0; j = (j - 1) & (int)totalN) {
                if (dpTable[i - 1][j] == 0) continue;
                int remaining = (int)totalN ^ j;
                for (mask = remaining; mask > j; mask = (mask - 1) & remaining) {
                    dpTable[i][j ^ mask] += dpTable[i - 1][j] * invFactorials[mask];
                    if (dpTable[i][j ^ mask] > HUGE_INF) dpTable[i][j ^ mask] %= modVal;
                }
            }
            for (j = (int)totalN; j > 0; j = (j - 1) & (int)totalN) {
                if (dpTable[i][j] >= modVal) dpTable[i][j] %= modVal;
            }
            long res = (dpTable[i][(int)totalN] * nCr((int)totalK, i)) % modVal;
            res = (res * factorials[i]) % modVal;
            totalAnswer = (totalAnswer + res) >= modVal ? totalAnswer + res - modVal : totalAnswer + res;
        }
        totalAnswer = (totalAnswer * factorials[(int)totalN]) % modVal;
        return totalAnswer;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        totalN = sc.nextLong();
        totalK = sc.nextLong();
        modVal = sc.nextLong();
        long answer = fastExponent(totalK, totalN);
        if (totalN % 2 == 0) answer = (answer - compute() + modVal) % modVal;
        System.out.println(answer);
        sc.close();
    }
}
